newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nippecraft in S$13.75 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Nippecraft in S$13.75 mln rights issue.

text.p: Diary maker Nippecraft said on Thursday it was proposing a one-for-four rights issue to raise about Singapore $13.75 million.
Each of the 50 million new shares of S$0.10 each in the rights issue will be offered at S$0.28 for every four existing shares, the company said in a statement.

The proceeds would be used to make the last instalment payment for its acquisition of the Diary and Stationary Division of Harper Collins Publishers ltd and to repay part of the loan taken to finance the acquisition, it said.
Nippecraft's major shareholder, St Kilda Investments Pte Ltd, would subscribe or obtain subscription for 27.625 million or 55.25 percent of the rights shares.
The remaining 22.375 million rights shares are underwritten by DBS Bank.
Application is being made to list the shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore. The issue is subject to the approval of the stock exchange and shareholders, the company said.
